events.title: Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
Lutnick challenges tariff reduction for Mexico
Trump waives some Russia sanctions, restrictions and energy-linked duties under the Graham Act
events.summary: Trump signed an executive order waiving application of certain sanctions, restrictions and duties under the Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act (signed Sept 18, initial measures due Oct 18) and certified to Congress that the waivers serve US national interests; Bloomberg says the waivers cover Russia energy tariffs.

events.title: South American 2026/27 early soybean planting pace at a record
events.summary: Early soybean planting in South America for the 2026/27 season is running at a record pace, Farms.com reported, adding to expectations of large Brazilian crops.

events.title: Lutnick challenges tariff reduction for Mexico
events.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick pushed back on a tariff reduction for Mexico, as auto parts makers seek guidance after Mexico limited its tariff break.

events.title: Wheat slips to two-month low as soybeans stay weak
events.summary: Wheat futures fell to a two-month low on Friday and soybeans remained weak as US harvest advances.

events.title: Indian processors urge ban on GM soybean imports
events.summary: Indian soybean processors urged the government to ban imports of genetically modified soybeans, as India scrutinises soybean cargoes.

events.title: Rubio says US-India trade deal is near finalisation
events.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US and India are close to finalising their trade agreement; the published framework cuts additional US duties on Indian goods from 25% to 18%.

events.title: Soybean futures fall below key moving average as US harvest advances
events.summary: CBOT soybean futures slipped below a key moving average as the US harvest advanced, with the Midwest seen on track for a strong crop.

events.title: US ambassador warns EU of 'devastating' retaliation if Brussels curbs Starlink spectrum access
events.summary: US envoy Andrew Puzder told the FT that European firms could face severe retaliation in the US if the EU reserves part of the satellite-to-phone spectrum for European operators; he also criticised the Cloud and AI Development Act and DMA fines.

events.title: US soybeans hit seven-week low as Brazil sees big crops
events.summary: US soybean futures fell to a seven-week low despite renewed Chinese purchases, as harvest pressure and fund selling weighed; Brazil's CONAB projects sizable soybean and corn crops for 2026/27.

events.title: Grains mixed after another US soybean sale to China
events.summary: US grain futures were mixed on October 15 after another US soybean export sale to China was reported.

events.title: USDA raises US corn and soybean yield estimates again
events.summary: Agweek reports USDA surprised the market with higher corn and soybean yield estimates; Chicago corn and soybeans declined.

events.title: India customs scrutiny of 'Niger-origin' soybeans diverts cargoes to other Asian buyers at discounts
events.summary: Indian customs is probing about 404,000 t of soybeans declared as Niger-origin this year (zero a year earlier), suspected to be Nigerian beans avoiding the 45% duty; about 60 containers are held at JNPT and Reuters reports cargoes are being diverted elsewhere in Asia at steep discounts.

events.title: Trump may decide in about 10 days on up to 100% tariffs on India over Russian oil
events.summary: A US sanctions law signed 18 September gives the president power to impose tariffs of up to 100% on Indian exports tied to Russian oil purchases, with a decision point around 18 October.

events.title: US copper stockpiles top 1 million tonnes on tariff front-running, but inflows slow
events.summary: Tariff threats pushed US copper stocks past 1 million tonnes, with Macquarie estimating about 1.6 million tonnes on and off exchange; inflows are now slowing as traders await a decision on the proposed refined copper tariff.

events.title: Progress toward US-Mexico tariff deal stalls over autos and metals, WSJ reports
events.summary: Talks to cut US tariffs on Mexican steel, aluminium and autos in exchange for Mexican concessions have lost momentum, with Commerce Secretary Lutnick reportedly opposing significant cuts to the 25% auto tariff and 50% steel and aluminium levies; Mexico's deputy trade minister said there was still progress.
